body.escapeReason: the claim census resolved a sourceItemId against the authored catalog but never checked whether that writer actually MINTS the record type, and scope-ordering let a dormant claim pass while authored in shape; a claim must resolve against the writer's PRODUCT, not just its identity, and scope checks must run before shape checks
applicability: every persisted claim whose source resolves to a typed writer (timed effects, timed jobs, timed modifiers)
proposedProtection: bound each claim class to the writer-shape inventory that produces it; order scope/dormant checks before writer-shape checks

body.escapeReason: persisted level claims were shape-checked >=1 while the writer's ceiling (template.maxLevel) was never consulted at the boundary or the effective-read seam
applicability: every persisted level/scale field with a writer ceiling (buildings, production sites, node levels)
proposedProtection: bound persisted levels to the writer maximum at shape AND clamp at the effective-read seam for non-save paths

body.escapeReason: consumer surfaces mapped domain getAll() outputs verbatim while the domain write seams were already gated; a carried dormant record rendered as a selectable row or an enabled-but-dead control - the rail verdict must reach the surface, not just the write path
applicability: every list/table/hero surface rendering a manager's getAll()/getActive() verbatim (skills, pills, techniques, bag counts)
proposedProtection: filter surfaces through the same admission predicate the write seam uses (betaSkillAdmitted / scopeHiddenPillFamilyOfId / betaTechniqueAdmitted); treat a non-admitted record as absent

body.escapeReason: the emit filter verified the claim's sourceId but not the ownership record that produces it - a grant claim survived with no owning talent selected
applicability: every persisted grant/effect claim whose existence is conditional on a sibling ownership record (talent grant, marker pair)
proposedProtection: emit requires the ownership witness (selectedTalentIds/marker); validator mirrors the same canonical shape

body.escapeReason: the hidden-progression flag enumerated dormant-record writers but missed highestFoundationAchieved='great_dao', so a save only hidden writers could produce loaded unflagged and emitted under lock
applicability: the unsupported-release/hidden-progression reason census - every field only a dormant writer can produce
proposedProtection: enumerate flag conditions over the closed writer inventory (great_dao is a hidden-writer product); suppress the gated emissions while locked

body.escapeReason: the settle path's retired exemption ran without the dormant-family check, so a retired-but-dormant job delivered its pill - an exemption applied before a scope check silently re-admits the record
applicability: every settle/deliver path with per-record exemptions (retired, legacy, unknown-id)
proposedProtection: scope/dormant checks run before all exemptions; exemptions may soften handling of LIVE records only

body.escapeReason: attributePoints was shape-checked >=0 but never bounded against the maximum earnable from the authored progression table (realmLevel + prior maxLevels)
applicability: every persisted currency/points field whose earning rate is closed-world enumerable (attribute points, mastery, insight)
proposedProtection: bound persisted accumulators to the max a writer could produce from the recorded progression state

body.escapeReason: deferred per Medium+-only ruling: externalModifiers lacks a claimed-source census, but the per-tick mirror overwrite scrubs forged entries after one frame - a transient window on hostile saves only
applicability: persisted slices mirrored per-tick by an authoritative recompute
proposedProtection: if the deferral is reversed, census externalModifiers like player.modifiers

body.escapeReason: deferred per Medium+-only ruling: CharacterPanel renders carried dormant talents + dormant-way aura - display-only on flagged saves, no live effect
applicability: display-only dormant renders on flagged saves
proposedProtection: if the deferral is reversed, filter selectedTalentIds via isBetaTalentId and gate the aura read via isBetaWay

body.escapeReason: latent hooks (runtime.buildSurviveSources, pill drop branch) lack scope gates but are unreachable at this commit - recorded so a future writer enabling the path sees the gate requirement
applicability: extension hooks with no live writer at the checked commit
proposedProtection: when a writer lands for a latent seam, the scope gate must ship with it
